title: Enhanced activity and chlorine protection in prolonged seawater electrolysis using MoS2/sulfonated reduced graphene oxide
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00541H, Paper
Prerna Tripathi, Renna Shakir, Amit Kumar Verma, J. Karthikeyan, Biswajit Ray, A. S. K. Sinha, Shikha Singh
Sulfonated graphene's ability to repel chlorine has been demonstrated experimentally and through DFT investigations. Notably, the article presents the novel importance of sulfonic moieties as repelling agents for sea water electrolysis.
